notablePrerequisites:
At least 1 instant or sorcery in hand with mana available to cast it.
{3}{R}{R} also available.
description:
Cast the spell in your hand.
In response cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to copy it.
Sevinne, the Chronoclasm's ability triggers copying Increasing Vengeance.
Copy the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat.
For each copy made Ral, Storm Conduit will trigger dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
